tasks.label: jupytext sync
tasks.detail: Pair + sync every .ipynb in the workspace with its .py twin
args: import glob, subprocess, sys; files = sorted(glob.glob('**/*.ipynb', recursive=True)); files = [f for f in files if '.ipynb_checkpoints' not in f]; print('No .ipynb files in workspace.') if not files else subprocess.run(['jupytext','--set-formats','ipynb,py:percent','--sync',*files])
